row.footnote: Refer to societies registered with the Registry of Societies as at end of year.
Includes cultural or heritage societies that are multi-disciplinary and do not specialise in an art form.

Refers to commercial (for-profit) and non-profit companies registered with the Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority as at end of year.  The number of arts and cultural companies include companies that (i) play a role in content creation/distribution such as sound recording production companies, publishing companies, (ii) deal with retailed musical instruments and photographic equipment, (iii) conduct classes/courses in the arts (e.g. dance, music lessons).  Data prior to 2020 are classified based on Singapore Standard Industrial Classification (SSIC) 2015.  Data from 2020 are classified based on SSIC 2020.
Includes cultural or heritage companies that are multi-disciplinary and do not specialise in an art form.
